question_text: Write the beginning of the story and complete it in your
stimulus: own words. 10 Long ago there was a famous king in a certain country. His name was king Solomon. He was the king of the Jews. He was the wisest man of his time. The king was famous all over the world for his knowledge and vast wisdom. Everyday many people asked him different questions. He answered all their questions perfectly. .....
